paper_title: What Does Neuro Mean to Cardio Investigating the Role of Clinical   Specialty Data in Medical LLMs
caption: Negative log-probabilities for clinically relevant tokens between baseline Mistral-v0.2 and the same model further fine-tuned on each specialty data. Each group represents tokens categorized into different clinical specialties. Each color means that the same model is further fine-tuned on each specialty data.

model_annotations.English: The grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for a baseline model compared to models fine-tuned on specific clinical specialty data. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Per-specialty terms" and displays six categories arranged alphabetically: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and features a linear scale ranging from -22 at the top down to -27 at the bottom, with numeric tick markers spaced at intervals of 1. Because the plotted values are negative, the vertical bars extend downward from the top baseline of -22. Each horizontal category contains a visual grouping of seven adjacent bars representing different model configurations as indicated by the top legend. The first bar in every group is colored light blue and represents the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model. The subsequent six bars in each group represent models "Fine-tuned on:" specific specialties, distinguished by a warm color gradient: lightest beige for Cardio, light peach for Gastro, medium-light orange for Infect, medium orange for Neuro, dark orange-brown for Obstetrics, and darkest brown for Pediatrics. The fine-tuned bars are consistently ordered alphabetically within each group, matching the arrangement in the legend. The downward lengths of the bars vary across the chart, with the light blue baseline model bars consistently extending the furthest down in every category. The longest downward bar overall is the baseline model in the Cardio category, reaching approximately -26.7. Conversely, the shortest downward bars, representing values closest to the -22 baseline, occur among the fine-tuned models, such as the light peach Gastro fine-tuned bar in the Infect category, which drops to roughly -23.0. The bars within each group are ordered categorically rather than being sorted by ascending or descending values, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations.
model_annotations.German: The grouped bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of clinically relevant per-specialty terms, comparing a baseline "Mistralv0.2-Base" model against models fine-tuned on six distinct clinical specialty datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," which are organized alphabetically from left to right: Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and features a downward-oriented linear scale ranging from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom, with numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. Consequently, all vertical bars extend downwards from the top baseline of -22. Each category on the horizontal axis contains a group of seven adjacent bars. According to the legend positioned above the chart, the first bar in each group is colored light blue and represents the "Mistralv0.2-Base" model. The subsequent six bars in each group correspond to the models "Fine-tuned on:" the specific specialties, which are arranged alphabetically and color-coded in a gradient from lightest to darkest: Cardio (lightest peach), Gastro (light orange), Infect (medium-light orange), Neuro (medium orange), Obstetrics (dark orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Visually, the light blue baseline bars extend the furthest downward in every group. The longest bar overall is the baseline model in the Cardio category, extending to approximately -26.8, while the shortest bars are found in the Infect category, where the fine-tuned models extend downward to only about -23.0. Within each category group, the six fine-tuned model bars display similar downward lengths, ranging broadly across the chart from roughly -23.0 to -26.1. Both the horizontal axis categories and the fine-tuned model legend items are sorted alphabetically, and no individual bars are visually emphasized with outlines or additional annotations.
